title: File-backed authentication for LLM gateway administration
intent: Allow Bahia to authenticate to an inference gateway administrator without persisting the bearer token in Bahia configuration.
scope: Add auth_token_file to each configured LLM gateway endpoint.
Resolve the token at Bahia startup and pass only the resolved value to the HTTP adapter.
Fail startup for missing, unreadable, empty, relative, or conflicting token sources.
out_of_scope: Provider credentials carried by LLM releases; those use secret-backed route headers.
